customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (content hash); one profile per covered member and one per plan sponsor organisation

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile is a covered member (an individual holding pharmacy benefits) or a plan sponsor (the employer, union or plan that contracts with Northbridge Rx)

name.meaning: full legal name of the member as on the enrollment file, or the legal entity name of the plan sponsor

date_of_birth.meaning: member date of birth as on the sponsor eligibility file; empty for plan sponsors

member_number.meaning: Northbridge Rx member ID printed on the member's prescription ID card (three letters followed by nine digits, e.g. NBX204418873); empty for plan sponsors

group_number.meaning: group number of the sponsor's pharmacy plan as printed on ID cards (e.g. NB-04417); a member carries the group they are covered under, a plan sponsor carries its own group number

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the plan sponsor's federal employer identification number; empty for members

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address on file (for members, also the default home delivery shipping ZIP)

state_code.meaning: state of the mailing address on file; state of residence for members, state of the principal office for plan sponsors

relationship.meaning: member's relationship to the subscriber (the employee or retiree through whom coverage is held); not_applicable for plan sponsors

subscriber_customer_id.meaning: customer id of the subscriber whose family coverage this member belongs to (equals the member's own customer_id for a subscriber); empty for plan sponsors

sponsor_customer_id.meaning: customer id of the plan sponsor whose group plan covers this member; empty for plan sponsors

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the profile was first created at Northbridge Rx

plan_enrollment_id.meaning: primary id of the member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment

sponsor_customer_id.meaning: plan sponsor whose group plan provides this coverage (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: plan design held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrollment (basis in products/plan.yaml lifecycle.states)

coverage_level.meaning: coverage level elected by the subscriber; every level other than employee_only uses family deductible and out-of-pocket amounts

coverage_effective_date.meaning: first day of coverage under this enrollment

coverage_end_date.meaning: last day of coverage; empty while coverage is open

plan_year_start_date.meaning: first day of the current plan year (the benefit period over which deductible and out-of-pocket accumulate)

cobra_notice_date.meaning: date the sponsor's COBRA administrator issued the COBRA election notice; empty unless coverage was lost with COBRA rights

cobra_end_date.meaning: last day of the COBRA continuation period; empty unless coverage is continued under COBRA

other_coverage.meaning: coordination-of-benefits status: whether the member has other prescription coverage and which payer is primary

other_coverage_verified_date.meaning: date the coordination-of-benefits status was last confirmed with the member; empty if never confirmed

deductible_met.meaning: deductible met in the current plan year; identically the sum of deductible postings minus deductible reversals and resets in the accumulator ledger

oop_met.meaning: out-of-pocket met in the current plan year; identically the sum of out-of-pocket postings minus reversals and resets in the accumulator ledger

plan_accumulator_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the accumulator ledger entry

plan_enrollment_id.meaning: enrollment whose accumulator moves (foreign key -> plan_enrollments)

event_type.meaning: accumulator event family, verbatim from products/plan.yaml

amount.meaning: magnitude of the accumulator movement, always positive; the event family fixes whether it raises or lowers the accumulator

accrual_date.meaning: date the amount accrues to: the date of service of the source claim, the medical-claim service date for feeds, the plan year start date for resets and carryovers, or the posting date for manual corrections

plan_year.meaning: calendar year in which the plan year the entry belongs to begins

source_reference_id.meaning: id of the originating record: the retail claim, home delivery order or specialty fill id for pharmacy claims, the original ledger entry id for manual corrections and reversals of feeds; empty for plan-year resets

channel.meaning: dispensing channel of the source claim; medical for carrier feeds; not_applicable otherwise

funding_source.meaning: who funded the cost share behind a pharmacy-claim posting; not_applicable for non-claim entries

formulary_tier.meaning: formulary tier at which the source pharmacy claim adjudicated; not_applicable for non-claim entries

claim_allowed_amount.meaning: plan-allowed drug cost of the source pharmacy claim on which the cost share was computed; 0.00 for non-claim entries

plan_service_record_id.meaning: primary id of the plan service record

event_type.meaning: service event family, verbatim from products/plan.yaml

request_date.meaning: date the service was requested or the questionnaire was sent/returned

card_reason.meaning: reason for an ID card reissue; not_applicable for questionnaires

delivery_method.meaning: how the replacement ID card is delivered; not_applicable for questionnaires

cob_response.meaning: member's coordination-of-benefits questionnaire answer; not_applicable for ID card reissues

variant_name.meaning: formulary assigned, written as the official full formulary name

effective_date.meaning: first day the member is covered under this assignment

end_date.meaning: last day of the assignment; empty while open

transition_start_date.meaning: first day of the member's transition window on this formulary: the formulary change date when the member was moved here by a sponsor formulary change, otherwise the effective date

formulary_change_date.meaning: date the current formulary replaced a different formulary for this member (sponsor formulary change); empty if the formulary never changed

review_priority.meaning: standard, or expedited because the prescriber attests that waiting could seriously jeopardize the member's life, health or ability to regain maximum function

prescriber_npi.meaning: National Provider Identifier of the prescriber

statement_basis.meaning: clinical ground given in the prescriber supporting statement; not_applicable on rows that carry no statement

event_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

formulary_notice_id.meaning: primary id of the formulary change notice
